title: Freight Damage Form
subtitle: Freight Damage: captures actual activity and handoff.
description: Freight Damage Form covers freight unit, packaging, damage area, affected quantity, custody event, and mitigation action. The freight exception coordinator records Freight Damage activity, quantities, variance, and handoff. Freight Damage Form keeps Freight Damage exceptions visible until the freight exception coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Freight Damage Form at trailer, dock, warehouse zone, delivery location, and protected evidence area. Document freight unit, packaging, damage area, affected quantity, custody event, and mitigation action identity before Freight Damage begins. Compare freight unit, packaging, damage area, affected quantity, custody event, and mitigation action findings with stated Freight Damage criteria; route unresolved Freight Damage issues to claims or cargo-condition reviewer. For Freight Damage Form, confirm requirements for Freight Damage. Ask claims or cargo-condition reviewer to review Freight Damage conditions beyond the freight exception coordinator's role.
